title: Call to paid
what: A customer phones in, gets booked, approves an estimate from her email and pays. Calls, customers, booking, dispatch, pricebook, estimates, invoices, payments and AR in one run.
note: Dispatch was refused because every A Star technician was busy on an older test job. The QuickBooks batch is skipped: A Star has no QuickBooks connection.

title: Declined, then sold
what: The customer turns down the first estimate, the office follows up, and a cheaper option gets signed.
note: Follow-ups appear once the job is completed, as in ServiceTitan.

title: Partial payment
what: Half paid in cash now, the rest by check later. AR shows the open half in between.

title: Refunds
what: Fifty dollars back from a check payment, then a cash payment refunded in full.
note: The known refund bugs BOS-4271 and BOS-4273 did not reproduce.

title: Membership on the visit
what: A membership is sold from the customer page, paid by check, and shows on the next booking.
note: Haven keeps a sold membership Pending until it is paid; ServiceTitan activates it at sale (BOS-4523). The list leaves Customer and Location empty (BOS-4524).
